description: This file contains utility functions for testing distributions in the Abseil C++ library, including statistical calculations, special math functions, and inverse functions related to the normal distribution and beta functions.

methods.name: ComputeDistributionMoments
methods.description: Calculates statistical moments (mean, variance, skewness, kurtosis) for a dataset.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs distribution moments to an ostream in formatted form.

methods.name: InverseNormalSurvival
methods.description: Computes the inverse survival function (quantile) of the standard normal distribution.

methods.name: Near
methods.description: Checks if two doubles are within a specified bound, logs if not.

methods.name: Beta
methods.description: Calculates the Beta function using gamma functions.

methods.name: BetaIncompleteInv
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of the incomplete beta function.

methods.name: RequiredSuccessProbability
methods.description: Calculates the success probability needed to achieve a certain failure probability over multiple trials.

methods.name: ZScore
methods.description: Calculates the Z-score given an expected mean and distribution moments.

methods.name: MaxErrorTolerance
methods.description: Calculates the maximum error tolerance for a given acceptance probability.
